The Stuck Not Broken app

A self-regulation practice built entirely for you, that changes with you.

You tell it how you're doing. It gives you a custom meditation practice designed for you and only you. Every check-in and every practice changes what it gives you next. Don't believe it? Try it free below to see your own before and after. Or, scroll to see a walkthrough of the app.

Do a practice now

The SNB app is not just another meditation app. It does more than provide kinda useful meditations that kinda help you feel better for maybe a little bit. It's a self-regulation app. It does one thing, and it does it seriously: slowly and sustainably increase your level of presence and distress tolerance.

A real app visit from start to finish

Everything below is a single afternoon in the app, shown in the order it happened. Nothing is staged and nothing is skipped. (Check the clock in the corner.)

1. it opens where you left off

The today tab is ready for your check-in, leads you through one intentional breath, gives a recommended practice based on your capacity, and a personal reader reflection.

Note there are zero streak counters. The app is a self-regulation tool you use as you want or need to. There are zero addictive elements to the SNB app. There is also no: AI, micro-transactions, treasure chests, costumes to buy, nothing to unlock... you get the idea. The app treats you like an adult who is serious about their emotional health.

2. you check in

The check-ins drive everything in the SNB app. Based on your reports, it designs custom self-regulation practices for you and your wonderful nervous system. Check-ins also provide deep data insights for you to learn about your system and how to best give it what it needs.

How often should you check in? As much as you like, but the app learns your patterns over time, so the more the merrier.

What happens to all this data? It sits in the background and the app adjusts everything based on it. You can delete your data at any time.

3. it builds you a practice

Practices are literally designed and built just for you based on a number of factors. Don't want the recommended custom one? That's fine, you can create your own.

Other meditation apps serve you pre-recorded whole meditations, which is fine, but those are general-purpose, temporary feel-goods. SNB's meditations are self-regulation practices, dynamically stitched together, tailored to what works for you.

4. practice with Justin

In the practice player, you'll see a simple visual (like the breath ring here), plus options to extend or reduce silence, and turn on closed captions.

The practices feature exactly zero celebrity voices. And no AI ones either. Just Justin, like you've been listening to on the podcast for years.

Need to end a practice early? That's fine. The player learns from it and adapts.

5. immediate before & after results

After you practice, you note how your system feels, then do another optional check-in using the same sliders as before. You'll see the before and after comparison immediately and the results are fed back into the app so it can learn what works best for you.

A personal reader

Your check-in and practice history data come together in the personal reader. It's like a blog that's relevant only to you. The personal reader features your data along with helpful information, like recommendations and things to keep an eye out for as your system starts to shift. Over the moments, days, weeks, months, and beyond, the reader continues to change as you do.

The stats playground

The You tab is where you go to learn more in-depth about your nervous system patterns. Identify the best times of day to practice, which practices are most effective, your level of safety over time, and much more.

The method isn't new

I designed the Stuck Not Broken app to make itself unnecessary. If it's working, you need it less over time, not more. There are zero addictive elements to hook you in longer.

The method underneath is the same one I've taught in the Unstucking Academy for years. It's the one I use in my own practice, and the one I walk clients through one-on-one. This is a new way to practice the Self-Regulation System on your own, in your own life, on the days you actually have.

In the first Self-Regulation Simplified group, people reported a 54% rise in confidence in their own regulation. That is their own before-and-after, from the live version, not from the app. The numbers are here.

Questions

01

What data is stored?

The app retains data based on things like check-ins, practices, and settings. Summaries are not stored, only raw data. This ensures the app works to customize and improve your experience as much as possible.

02

Who can read my data?

Technically, I can access the app's data at any time as the owner and administrator of the app. But in general, I won't. The data in the app is stored along with your sign in information. But I also have a mirror of the data that strips away anything identifiable. When I look at data (to make sure the app is working and results are trending positively), I look at the de-identified data. Your data is never released and never sold.

03

Can I delete my data?

Yes, you can delete your identifiable data any time you want, from your settings in the app. When you delete your data or your account, the mirrored de-identified data remains, which helps me improve the app further.

04

Is the app finished?

It's finished and ready for you! It's in its early stages with major plans for the future.
